items.title: Annie Ross interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2001
items.q: Yeah, and Zoot. I loved that.

ctx.x: Now that’s a good match for you I think?

Yeah, and Zoot. I loved that. You know, records or CDs, or whatever you want to call them, are like children. You know it’s very hard to find — you maybe have a sentimental favorite, because of everything that it involved. It’s very hard to choose one particular one that you say is the best for you. Because I think all of them have something.
If I was to put on one tune from this, would you have a favorite?
